timeline.description: Developing and maintaining custom Shopify themes and apps for e-commerce clients. Implementing UI/UX solutions with Shopify Liquid, JS, HTML, CSS3.
Building e-commerce applications using the Shopify ecosystem. Custom Shopify themes and apps. Working with Shopify Liquid, React.js, Remix.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shopify Hydrogen, GraphQL.
Building e-commerce applications. Working with Vue.js v2.x, Vuex, JavaScript, Jest, Vuetify, Atomic Design, BEM.
Building e-commerce applications. Projects for brands such as Marilyn, Tatuum, Mastivo, Gabi.net, Varlesca, Alles, Cosmedica, Urbancity. Working with Vue.js, Vuex, jQuery, Twig, Bootstrap, Webpack.
Building web applications with React.js. Migrating a project from AngularJS to React.js. Working with JavaScript, jQuery, Jest, React Testing Library, Material UI, Styled Components, Webpack.
Building websites based on Sylius CMS. Working with HTML5, Twig, CSS3, Scss, JavaScript ES6, jQuery, Semantic UI, Gulp, Webpack.
Co-developing a portal for one of the largest e-commerce companies in Austria. Working with HTML5, CSS3, Sass, JavaScript ES6, jQuery, Bootstrap v4, Webpack, Thymeleaf.
Co-developing a portal for one of the largest multi-level marketing companies in cosmetics and personal care. Working with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6, jQuery, Bootstrap v3, WordPress.
Delivering projects for major brands (Bank Pekao S.A., PLAY, Emirates NBD — Dubai business trip). Building websites with HTML5, CSS3, Sass, JavaScript, jQuery, Foundation, Gulp.js.
